title: Caramel Clouds
statementMd:
![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5185b1d51cfa7498a3fa4953610015c90bd5bf3a.png)

It is well-known that the best decoration for a flower bed in Sweetland are vanilla muffins. Seedlings of this plant need sun to grow up. Slastyona has $*m*$ seedlings, and the $*j*$-th seedling needs at least $*k*_{*j*}$ minutes of sunlight to grow up.

Most of the time it's sunny in Sweetland, but sometimes some caramel clouds come, the $*i*$-th of which will appear at time moment (minute) $*l*_{*i*}$ and disappear at time moment $*r*_{*i*}$. Of course, the clouds make shadows, and the seedlings can't grow when there is at least one cloud veiling the sun.

Slastyona wants to grow up her muffins as fast as possible. She has exactly $*C*$ candies, which is the main currency in Sweetland.

One can dispel any cloud by paying $*c*_{*i*}$ candies. However, in order to comply with Sweetland's Department of Meteorology regulations, **one can't dispel more than two clouds**.

Slastyona hasn't decided yet which of the $*m*$ seedlings will be planted at the princess' garden, so she needs your help. For each seedling determine the earliest moment it can grow up if Slastyona won't break the law and won't spend more candies than she has. Note that each of the seedlings is considered independently.

The seedlings start to grow at time moment $0$.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*C*$ $(0 ≤ *n* ≤ 3·10^{5}, 0 ≤ *C* ≤ 10^{9})$ – the number of caramel clouds and the number of candies Slastyona has.

The next $*n*$ lines contain three integers each: $*l*_{*i*}, *r*_{*i*}, *c*_{*i*}$ $(0 ≤ *l*_{*i*} < *r*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}, 0 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9})$, describing one caramel cloud.

The next line contains single integer $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *m* ≤ 3·10^{5})$ – the number of seedlings. Each of the seedlings is described with one integer $*k*_{*j*}$ $(1 ≤ *k*_{*j*} ≤ 10^{9})$ – the required number of sunny minutes.

## Output

For each seedling print one integer – the minimum minute Slastyona can grow it up.

## Note

Consider the first example. For each $*k*$ it is optimal to dispel clouds $1$ and $3$. Then the remaining cloud will give shadow on time segment $[1..6]$. So, intervals $[0..1]$ and $[6..*inf*)$ are sunny.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/066cb0a5b4f145a41f36e530fefa508526cf0dd7.png)

In the second example for $*k* = 1$ it is not necessary to dispel anything, and for $*k* = 5$ the best strategy is to dispel clouds $2$ and $3$. This adds an additional sunny segment $[4..8]$, which together with $[0..1]$ allows to grow up the muffin at the eight minute.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/30073914a2965dd1e90d706eeb3862cc8b8be2b8.png) ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70012638d03549012795eea6f5030e5ce37f1137.png)

If the third example the two seedlings are completely different. For the first one it is necessary to dispel cloud $1$ and obtain a sunny segment $[0..10]$. However, the same strategy gives answer $180$ for the second seedling. Instead, we can dispel cloud $2$, to make segments $[0..3]$ and $[7..*inf*)$ sunny, and this allows up to shorten the time to $104$.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5185b1d51cfa7498a3fa4953610015c90bd5bf3a.png)

众所周知，香草松饼是甜蜜国花坛最好的装饰。这种植物的幼苗需要阳光才能生长。Slastyona 有 $*m*$ 株幼苗，其中第 $*j*$ 株幼苗至少需要 $*k*_{*j*}$ 分钟的阳光才能长大。

甜蜜国大部分时间都是晴天，但有时会出现焦糖云。第 $*i*$ 片焦糖云会在时刻（分钟）$*l*_{*i*}$ 出现，并在时刻 $*r*_{*i*}$ 消失。当然，云会形成阴影，当至少有一片云遮住阳光时，幼苗就无法生长。

Slastyona 希望尽快让她的松饼长大。她正好有 $*C*$ 颗糖果，这是甜蜜国的主要货币。

支付 $*c*_{*i*}$ 颗糖果可以驱散任意一片云。但是，为了遵守甜蜜国气象部门的规定，**不能驱散超过两片云**。

Slastyona 还没有决定将 $*m*$ 株幼苗中的哪一株种在公主的花园里，因此她需要你的帮助。对于每株幼苗，求出在不违法且不花费超过现有糖果的情况下，它最早能够长大的时刻。注意，每株幼苗都需要独立计算。

幼苗从时刻 $0$ 开始生长。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*C*$ $(0 ≤ *n* ≤ 3·10^{5}, 0 ≤ *C* ≤ 10^{9})$ ——焦糖云的数量以及 Slastyona 拥有的糖果数量。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行中，每行包含三个整数：$*l*_{*i*}, *r*_{*i*}, *c*_{*i*}$ $(0 ≤ *l*_{*i*} < *r*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}, 0 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9})$，表示一片焦糖云。

接下来一行包含一个整数 $*m*$ $(1 ≤ *m* ≤ 3·10^{5})$ ——幼苗的数量。每株幼苗用一个整数 $*k*_{*j*}$ $(1 ≤ *k*_{*j*} ≤ 10^{9})$ 描述，表示其所需的阳光照射时间（分钟数）。

## 输出格式

对于每株幼苗，输出一个整数——Slastyona 使其长大的最早时刻。

## 说明

考虑第一个样例。对于每个 $*k*$，驱散云 1 和 3 是最优选择。此时剩下的云会在时间段 $[1..6]$ 形成阴影。因此，时间段 $[0..1]$ 和 $[6..*inf*)$ 是晴天。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/066cb0a5b4f145a41f36e530fefa508526cf0dd7.png)

在第二个样例中，对于 $*k* = 1$，无需驱散任何云；而对于 $*k* = 5$，最优策略是驱散云 2 和 3。这样会额外增加一段晴天区间 $[4..8]$，它与 $[0..1]$ 合起来可以让松饼在第八分钟长大。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/30073914a2965dd1e90d706eeb3862cc8b8be2b8.png) ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70012638d03549012795eea6f5030e5ce37f1137.png)

在第三个样例中，两株幼苗完全不同。对于第一株幼苗，必须驱散云 1，从而得到晴天区间 $[0..10]$。然而，对第二株幼苗采用相同策略时，答案为 $180$。相反，我们可以驱散云 2，使区间 $[0..3]$ 和 $[7..*inf*)$ 变为晴天，这样可以将时间缩短至 $104$。
